name: Libni
overview: Libni is identified in Scripture as a son of Gershon, one of the Levite patriarchs, with his descendants known as the Libnites. The passages in Exodus and Numbers detail the familial structure of the Gershonites, highlighting Libni and his family as integral parts of the Levite lineage. Additionally, Libni is noted as a grandson of Merari, another Levite ancestor, situating him within the broader Levitical genealogy essential to Israel's priestly heritage.
